title: The road is just getting started
story: Andy is out wandering, looking for the things other people pass by. Real finds and stories will start appearing here as he sends them in from the road.

title: What catches Andy's eye?
location: Estate sales, flea markets & back roads
story: Old advertising, tools, paper, signs, unusual household pieces, collectibles and the occasional thing that simply has a story. There is no rigid list — that is part of the fun.

title: Looking for something specific?
story: Put it on Andy's list. A photo, memory, model number or half-remembered description may be enough. If he sees a promising match, he can get in touch.
